overview: A beginner roadmap for learning visual design principles, simple tools, and portfolio-ready practice projects.

phases.title: Design Foundations
phases.goal: Learn the basic principles behind clear visual communication.

nodes.title: Layout and composition
nodes.description: Study alignment, proximity, hierarchy, and whitespace. Practice recreating simple layouts to understand why they work.

nodes.title: Color basics
nodes.description: Learn contrast, harmony, and accessibility basics. Build small palettes and test whether text remains readable.

nodes.title: Typography
nodes.description: Understand font pairing, size, line height, and hierarchy. Practice making text easier to scan without adding decoration.

project.title: Event poster redesign
project.brief: Redesign a simple event poster with better hierarchy, spacing, and contrast. Create two versions with different color palettes.

phases.title: Tool Practice
phases.goal: Use common design tools to create clean assets.

nodes.title: Figma or Canva basics
nodes.description: Learn frames, shapes, text, images, and exporting. Focus on repeatable workflow instead of advanced effects.

nodes.title: Image and icon usage
nodes.description: Learn how to choose images and icons that support the message. Keep styles consistent across one design.

nodes.title: Exporting for web and social
nodes.description: Understand common file formats and sizes. Export work clearly so it can be used by teammates or clients.

project.title: Social media campaign set
project.brief: Design three matching social posts for a fictional product, keeping typography, colors, and image treatment consistent.

phases.title: Portfolio Practice
phases.goal: Create small finished pieces and explain design decisions.

nodes.title: Brand basics
nodes.description: Learn how logos, colors, type, and tone work together. Build a small visual identity for a fictional brand.

nodes.title: Feedback and iteration
nodes.description: Learn to compare versions and improve weak areas. Ask for specific feedback on hierarchy, readability, and consistency.

nodes.title: Case study writing
nodes.description: Write short notes explaining the problem, choices, and final result. A simple case study is more useful than a silent image gallery.

project.title: Mini brand kit
project.brief: Create a logo, color palette, typography guide, and two sample assets for a fictional beginner-friendly brand.
